subject: Shiny server: Error: non-numeric argument to binary operator

messages.author: 80ac11e65419558c
messages.subject: Shiny server: Error: non-numeric argument to binary operator
parts:
Hi all,

I have an app that works fine without errors locally and on ShinyApps.io, however, I get the following error when I upload it to my server that runs Shiny Server:

Error: non-numeric argument to binary operator

Error log: 

Warning in is.na(value) :

  is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'environment'

Error in value - private$min : non-numeric argument to binary operator

Warning in is.na(value) :

  is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'environment'

Error in value - private$min : non-numeric argument to binary operator

I've looked through my code to see where is.na() is used but there are no errors with any of them, and I also can't figure out what kind of object private$min is because it's not in my code. I've also deleted the app and re-uploaded everything and restarted the Shiny Server but the same problem comes up. Any clue how to debug this would be appreciated!

- JR

messages.author: d378c45b74a75e0a
messages.subject: Re: Shiny server: Error: non-numeric argument to binary operator
parts:
Hello

I had the same problem when I updated shinyIncubator() on my laptop.

private$min is a variable within the progressbars you get in shinyIncubator, see here:

https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-incubator

I would imagine you have different versions of shinyIncubator on your local server and on ShinyApps.io.  A good test would be to get rid of your progress bar(s) and re-test the code.  If it's the problem, re-code your progress bars for the new syntax accordingly.

Thanks
